{{Top|leg}}
'''Automatic safety systems''' were [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] devices placed along traffic corridors in [[City/Legends|urban]] areas to monitor traffic conditions and alert travelers of any potential hazardous situations. The system employed a series of sequential warning lights along with overhead illumi-markers and flashing danger panels. The automatic safety system would also notify [[Traffic Central]] of any problematic issues, so they could determine a course of resolution.
